mapper.sql: ad.id, ad.account_id, ad.agent_id, ad.type, ad.amount, ad.balance_before, ad.balance_after, ad.related_id, ad.description, ad.create_time, a.agent_name as agent_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM account_details ad LEFT JOIN agents a ON ad.agent_id = a.id WHERE ad.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM account_details ad LEFT JOIN agents a ON ad.agent_id = a.id WHERE ad.agent_id = #{agentId} ORDER BY ad.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_details WHERE agent_id = #{agentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_details (account_id, agent_id, type, amount, balance_before, balance_after, related_id, description, create_time) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{agentId}, #{type}, #{amount}, #{balanceBefore}, #{balanceAfter}, #{relatedId}, #{description}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
